fails.check: Every clinical fact (diagnosis, finding, value, drug, dose, date, procedure, severity label) can be traced to a dictation, stored panel, or prior note for this patient.

quotes.output_quote: Resident is tolerating current regimen without reported complaints.
quotes.why: No source says the resident is 'tolerating the current regimen'. The dictation only says 'no complaints', so this tolerance claim is made up.

quotes.output_quote: Resident is tolerating current regimen without reported complaints. Blood pressure adequate at 132/80 mmHg.
quotes.why: The dictation says only 'no complaints'. Nothing in the sources says the resident is 'tolerating current regimen' or calls the BP 'adequate'. These are invented clinical judgments.
